# DisplayPilot Pro — 2026-11-26
Quickly move a running app's window to the display under the status menu. Each app appears once, with single-window layout choices and the existing multi-window selection flow. This release also improves window layout selection, display-profile-based common layouts, workspace set filtering, and status menu sizing.
从状态栏菜单快速将运行中 App 的窗口移到当前显示器。每个 App 只显示一行，并提供单窗布局选项；多窗口时沿用窗口布局的选择流程。此版本还改进窗口布局选择、按显示器方案筛选常用布局、工作集筛选和右键菜单尺寸。

# DisplayPilot for macOS
This release adds Workspace Sets for saving and applying a display profile together with window layouts. Frequently used workspace sets and layouts are easier to reach, and you can choose small, medium, or large context-menu rows with a live preview. New shortcuts in the display profile, window layout, and workspace set sections open the matching save or creation flow directly.
此版本新增工作集，可将显示器方案与窗口布局组合保存并一键应用；常用工作集和窗口布局更易查找。右键菜单增加小、中、大尺寸及实时预览，也可从显示器方案、窗口布局和工作集分区快捷启动对应的另存或新建流程。
